label: RadarCount
description: Counts the vehicles that pass you using your ANT+ rear radar and shows their speed and distance in data fields styled like the Karoo's own. Writes the same developer fields to the ride FIT file as the Garmin MyBikeTraffic app, so rides upload to mybiketraffic.com. No alerts, no sounds, no network access. Open source, MIT licensed.
releaseNotes:
* A passing car's speed shows after one second instead of two, and mybiketraffic.com no longer shows the start of each car at your own speed
* Fixed: a car could go uncounted after a radar dropout
* New app icon, and RadarCount's row in the field picker is no longer blank
* Settings shows the build's commit next to the version
